Jordan — thanks, I received the signed NDA (attached for our audit). Per the agreement, please find our baseline hosted-API pricing attached (Redwood_Pricing_2026_v1.pdf). Highlights:

- Baseline list pricing (hosted API):
  - Text generation: $0.015 / 1K tokens (prompt), $0.030 / 1K tokens (completion)
  - Embeddings: $0.0009 / vector (128-d)
  - Streaming: included for low-latency endpoints (no additional per-request fee)

- Volume discounts: tiered discounts applied to monthly spend:
  - $0-$25k / month: list
  - $25k-$100k / month: 10% off list
  - $100k-$250k / month: 18% off list
  - >$250k / month: custom (contact AE)

- Introductory offer: we can do a time-limited first-year credit/discount for new customers. Typical starting point is 15% on the first 12 months for a 12-month committed spend above $50k/month. For larger commits we can authorize up to 20% with Sales Manager approval.

Notes: this is the v1 rate sheet. If you want a quote that includes reserved/dedicated capacity (Dedicated) or private deployment pricing, I will produce a v1.1 that separates those line items. The PDF is marked internal; please keep it within your procurement/compliance team per the NDA.

Next steps: if you can confirm a target monthly volume I will ask Dev (cc'd) to draft an itemized quote and a DocuSign contract with the discount tier we agree on. Also happy to set up a 30-minute pricing walk-through — are you available Thursday morning PST?

Best,
Rafael Mendes

Redwood Inference
